manifest.package_name: Clinic Management & Medical Expert System - Knowledge Base Starter
manifest.important_note: Disease catalog entries and symptom vocabulary are a bilingual starter index. No disease-symptom mappings or diagnostic rules are activated because those require disease-specific evidence and clinical review. Do not use for diagnosis or treatment.
recommended_workflow: verify exact ICD-11 code and official title
attach disease-specific source URLs and access/review dates
write rule with inclusion/exclusion and safety conditions

sources.use: Disease-specific background and warning signs for dengue; not a standalone diagnostic rule.
